doc.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016

title: Mother's memory and closing thanks
summary: He recalls his mother and the church, then thanks Rowe and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Oh and beautiful as ever. I had a flood of memories coming back, mostly about my mom who passed in ’94. She was only 58. But she was our Unitarian church choir director. So I could feel her there yesterday.
Is there anything that you wanted to add that I didn’t ask?
No. Other than to say thank you and I’m flattered and honored to be here. Yeah, it’s really nice.
Yeah. Well you’re in good company. Those people behind you in those notebooks, you’re sharing — some good bass players especially.
Absolutely. No I’m honored to be here, believe me. Honored and humbled.
Okay. Well thanks for your time.
